certification.name: IBM Cybersecurity Analyst Professional Certificate
certification.description: Fourteen-course entry-level program covering security tools, operating systems, networking, databases, compliance frameworks, penetration testing, incident response and forensics, with a capstone. Course-based certificate assessed through labs and projects, with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 4 months at 10 hours a week.
